news.title: Players Who Defined an Entire World Cup
news.lede: The World Cup has never felt like just another football competition. Every four years, it seems to produce players who step out of the ordinary and leave something lasting behind. It is not always the top scorer or even the captain of the winning side who stands out, but often the one who carries their team through the pressure and expectation. Some moments are defined by brilliance, others by controversy, yet certain players end up shaping the entire feel of a tournament.

news.title: Kenya’s Junior Starlets bow out of 2026 World Cup in Round of 16 after defeat to Japan
news.lede: Kenya’s Junior Starlets historic 2026 U-17 FIFA World Cup journey came to an end on Thursday night after former champions Japan staged a comeback to edge them out in a 3-1 defeat at the Mohammed VI Football Academy in Sale, Morocco. It was Kenya who took the lead against the run of play when Brenda Achieng charged towards goal and slotted the ball past Kou Kadowaki into the corner of the net, giving Mildred Cheche’s side their first-ever goal in the knockout stage. However, they did not hold on to their advantage for long. A long-range effort from Harura Matsushita deflected into the path of Mei Hanashiro, who fired home with power.

news.title: Japan end junior starlets' historic FIFA U-17 world cup campaign
news.lede: The Kenyan youngsters had made a promising start, with Brenda Achieng putting the Junior Starlets ahead and raising hopes of another memorable performance on the global stage.
